create_episode_model: create an Episode ORM model instance with an EpisodeId, TaskId, and DataPath
create_tag_model: create a Tag ORM model instance with a human readable tag name
create_reward_sequence_model: create a RewardSequence ORM model with EpisodeId, RewardSequenceId, and binary reward values
create_archive_file_model: create an ArchiveFile ORM model linking an EpisodeId to its archive file name
create_episode_tag_association: create an EpisodeTag association table linking episodes to tags via foreign keys
